Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I am sure that this is not all that I have shown to you.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: If it is, that is because we are constantly distracted with other matters. And for that, I am sorry. You deserve better.

Line.Text: But I do not wish for this to make you doubt who I am. Maybe it is true that I have spent very little time on talking about France itself, but do not let that help others deceive you !

Choices.Text: Do you know who that Kweebec is, then?
